final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(1.0 * m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanmesh AS m JOIN sites AS s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.insurstat), step2 AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS insurance_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT a.insurstat, AVG(a.avg_ratio), COUNT(*), AVG(a.avg_ratio - b.insurance_avg) FROM step1 AS a JOIN step2 AS b ON a.insurstat = b.insurstat WHERE a.avg_ratio > b.insurance_avg GROUP BY a.insurstat
